officialPlatform.operator: Ministry of Municipalities and Housing / Balady
officialPlatform.scopeClaim: National urban map; official service description includes streets and land parcels; city-level cadastral layer and identity not anonymously readable.

bundleEvidence.assessment: Configuration metadata only persisted; credentials and API keys omitted.

officialPlatform.heldReason: Service root anonymously lists official folders, but umaps,MOJ,Hosted folder reads return ArcGIS 499 Token Required under HTTP200. Portal item inaccessible (400). No parcel polygon layer/ID contract readable.

municipalChecks.Riyadh: Official eservices.alriyadh.gov.sa MapViewer timed out through both web fetch and laptop verified TLS.
municipalChecks.Jeddah: www.jeddah.gov.sa and services.jeddah.gov.sa timed out on direct laptop TLS.
municipalChecks.EasternGulf: www.eamana.gov.sa timed out; guessed gis.eamana.gov.sa/maps.eamana.gov.sa fail DNS, separately classified as guesses, not provider absence.

additionalActualAttempts.assessment: Redirect discards path to canonical domain; followed response was SPA HTML; direct canonical script works.

termsNote: Informational only; not a licence rejection. Held reasons are technical authentication and network failures.
notAbsence: This audit does not assert Saudi parcel data is absent; official platform expressly advertises parcel data.
